| [Procedure](procedure.md) | Skill Reference | Formerly the skill od-use-case-prioritization, absorbed into bc-portfolio on 2026-11-10 to remove duplication against the department context. Rank several competing candidate use cases for a plant or region into a recommended order, against the plant roadmap and strategic-plant scope, and write the ranking down as a prioritization record with the evidence behind each position. Uses OD's own criteria (saving potential, generalization potential, roadmap link, effort and dependencies) and keeps unscored use cases in a separate bucket. Use when more than one use case is waiting for the same capacity, after a definition workshop has collected demand, before a planning round or roadmap input, or when a plant asks which of its use cases OD |
